role_voices.text_zh: 生命的逝去，很自然。不必悲傷惋惜……
role_voices.text_en: The passing of life is a part of nature. There is no need to dwell on the sadness...
Emotions? I don't really, understand, what they mean.
The feeling of pain? I'm not familiar with it...

role_voices.text_zh: 海拉不需要朋友。一直都是……一個人……
role_voices.text_en: I do not need any friends. I've always been... on my own...

role_voices.text_zh: 黑暗也沒什麼不好，從我有記憶以來，都在黑暗中度過。
role_voices.text_en: There's nothing wrong with darkness. I was living in darkness ever since I was born.

role_voices.text_zh: 「怪孩子」，大家都這麼叫我，你也覺得我奇怪嗎？
role_voices.text_en: Everyone calls me the "Odd Child". Do you think I'm strange too?

role_voices.text_zh: 為什麼一直跟著我？是希望我陪嗎？我倒是無所謂……
role_voices.text_en: Why are you following me? Do you wish to keep me company? I'm fine with that...

role_voices.text_zh: 不可以……這樣玩弄……我的身體……♥#討厭你？我也沒那樣說……
role_voices.text_en: Don't... toy with... my body...♥#Hate you? I didn't say that...

role_voices.text_zh: 帶我到外面的世界看看？這個時候要表達感謝嗎？好吧，謝謝。
role_voices.text_en: You want to show me the outside world? Is this the right moment to express gratitude? Okay, thank you.

role_voices.text_zh: 聽到了嗎？亡者的哀號，你也成為他們的一員吧。
role_voices.text_en: Do you hear that? The wails of the dead. You should become one of them.
See you in the other world...
Anyone who gets in my way will all...
Finally... I can get some proper rest...

role_voices.text_zh: 勝利了？對我來說都一樣。
role_voices.text_en: Did we win? It's all the same to me
